title: LOCALWR spill scheduling: baseline a987650 versus corrected run
units: DRAM CK; absolute command clocks; half-open CA intervals; phase boundaries retain fractional CK

evidence.observed_spill_change: Spill wall time changes by -40 CK; its last channel-0 LOCALWR issue changes by -40 CK.
evidence.downstream_change: Downstream phases save 49 CK in total. This is an observed downstream scheduling change; refresh, row-state and CA contributions have not been independently attributed.
evidence.occupancy_method: Each other-bank LOCALWR is matched to its rank1 CA reservation. Only exactly adjacent reservations within that bank's ACT1-to-ACT2 interval are merged.
evidence.causal_limit: Continuous LOCALWR occupancy proves the shared rank CA was unavailable during those CKs. It does not prove ACT2 was timing-eligible for every CK or that all latency changes are ACT stalls.

scope: Chain latency/phases; detailed spill command scheduling is channel 0 only. No simulation rerun.
